section.37: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

37.name_native: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Abu Bakrah said:"The Messenger [SAW] said: 'If two Muslims meet (and fight) with their swords and one of them kills the other, the killer and the slain will both be in Hell
